# PhysxTendonAxisRootAPI

Root axis of a fixed tendon, applied as PhysxTendonAxisRootAPI:<tendon>. Besides its axis the parser emits the tendon itself with these spring, limit and enable settings. Values are clamped and an infinite value saturates.

- **Applies to:** [`PhysicsJoint`](glossary.md#physicsjoint)
- **Multi-apply:** applied as `PhysxTendonAxisRootAPI:<instance>`; `<inst>` in a column name is the instance. Instances: any instance name.
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**

## What USD population writes

Every declared attribute of an applied instance is published at its resolved value; [USD](glossary.md#usd) auto-applies PhysxTendonAxisAPI:<tendon> with it.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the USD schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `physxTendon:<inst>:stiffness` | float32 | force/length | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0.0. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:limitStiffness` | float32 | force/length | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0.0. A positive value without finite limits logs a warning. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:damping` | float32 | force*s/length | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0.0. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:offset` | float32 | length | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0.0. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:restLength` | float32 | length | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | `-FLT_MAX` **diverges** | -FLT_MAX (unset). USD's fallback 0.0 is a rest length, so write the value. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:lowerLimit` | float32 | length | `-inf` | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | `-FLT_MAX` | -FLT_MAX: no lower limit. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:upperLimit` | float32 | length | `inf` | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | `FLT_MAX` | FLT_MAX: no upper limit. Clamped to at least the lower limit. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:tendonEnabled` | bool8 | none | true | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | true | true. |

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxTendonAxisAPI`](PhysxTendonAxisAPI.md):** Owns gearing and forceCoefficient, which the parser reads for the root axis as well.

## Notes

- Instance names are arbitrary (one per tendon), so the compiled cache declares every physxTendon:* column.
